content:
One last World Cup, one last shot at the trophy. Virat Kohli has confirmed that the 2027 ODI World Cup will be his last World Cup for India.

Speaking to JioStar, Kohli said: “For me, it's the last World Cup I'm going to play for India. And that is my motivation.”

He made his goal clear to win the World Cup and leave everything out there.

The 2027 ODI World Cup will be played across South Africa, Zimbabwe and Namibia.

For a player who has spent years carrying expectations, breaking records and creating unforgettable moments, this will be another defining chapter.

One final World Cup, one final dream & one more chance to bring the trophy home.
comment: Beyond the trophy, the interesting part will be how he manages transition—balancing personal ambition, team needs and mentoring the next generation while chasing one last title.
